# Task: OG Image: Load a Custom Font Instead of Generic sans-serif ## Description ## Overview ## Problem `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx:20` sets `fontFamily: 'sans-serif'` in the root style, and passes no `fonts` array to `ImageResponse`. Satori renders OG images without a real font, producing inconsistent text across platforms. ## What to Change ### 1. Add a font file Download Inter Bold (SIL Open Font License) and save it to `public/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf`. A .ttf file is required — ttf/otf parse faster than woff per the Next.js docs. Download URL (from Bunny Fonts CDN or Google Fonts): ``` https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v18/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_fvQtMwCp50KnMa1ZL7W0Q5nw.woff2 ``` Note: ImageResponse only supports ttf/otf/woff — not woff2. Use the TTF variant from the Inter GitHub releases (`Inter-Bold.ttf` from https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases). ### 2. Update `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` Change the function to `async`, import `readFile` and `join`, load the font, and wire it into `ImageResponse`: ```tsx import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'; import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { join } from 'node:path'; export const alt = 'My App'; export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 }; export const contentType = 'image/png'; export const dynamic = 'force-static'; export default async function OgImage() { const fontData = await readFile( join(process.cwd(), 'public/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf') ); return new ImageResponse( (

My App

), { ...size, fonts: [ { name: 'Inter', data: fontData, style: 'normal', weight: 700, }, ], } ); } ``` ### 3. `src/app/twitter-image.tsx` — no change needed It re-exports the default function from `opengraph-image.tsx`, so it automatically picks up the fix. ## Acceptance Criteria - `npm run build` completes without error - The OG image renders with crisp, consistent Inter Bold text - `public/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf` is committed to the repo - `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` exports an async function that loads and registers the font ## Context - **Category:** feature - **Priority Score:** 7/10 - **Estimated Complexity:** low ## Reasoning Generic sans-serif renders inconsistently across Satori's rendering backend and social media preview scrapers.
